Usage: vespper-mcp [options]

Edit local DOCX files through Vespper over MCP.

Options:
  -V, --version               output the version number
  --mcp-url <url>             Hosted Vespper MCP URL (default:
                              "https://mcp.vespper.com/mcp", env:
                              VESPPER_MCP_URL)
  --author <name>             Default tracked-change author (default: "Vespper
                              Agent")
  --allowed-directory <path>  Directory containing editable DOCX files;
                              repeatable (default: [])
  -h, --help                  display help for command
